title: NCRIC Astrometrics platform access/usage data and vendor wind-down records
summary: Requests, distinct from the SOP 205.5.1 end-user audits the Department has twice said don't exist (W012461-040226, W012666-050426): (1) any access, usage, or audit data concerning the NCRIC Astrometrics platform the Department obtained from NCRIC or its vendor for any purpose, including logs of end-user sign-on, search terms/case numbers, or the justification tied to a search; (2) any request or correspondence by which the Department asked NCRIC or its vendor for that data; (3) records concerning the disposition of SMPD ALPR data on termination, wind-down, or cessation of the vendor operating NCRIC Astrometrics, including certificates of destruction or migration/transition records; and (4) any notice the Department received from NCRIC or the vendor about the vendor's wind-down/status change, data migration or deletion, or public disclosure of the platform's infrastructure code — including a record showing no such notice was received, if one exists.

policy_promises.quote: Our Department can obtain such data for the purposes of an audit directly from the NCRIC.
policy_promises.tests: Whether the Department will actually obtain and produce the underlying NCRIC-held access/usage data it says it is entitled to, having twice claimed no responsive audit records exist.

policy_promises.quote: is also maintained by Amazon Web Services and available for review and audit by SMPD
policy_promises.tests: Whether the Department applies the same third-party-hosting-is-available-to-us principle it states for Flock/AWS and Vigilant/Verio to the NCRIC Astrometrics hosting provider.

policy_promises.quote: Member Agencies remain the official custodian of all information contributed to the NCRIC-DSP
policy_promises.tests: Whether NCRIC-held records of SMPD's contributed ALPR data are treated as SMPD's own writings under Gov. Code §7920.530 regardless of which server they reside on.

filed_because: The Department has twice told the requester no responsive records exist for SOP 205.5.1 end-user audits of the NCRIC Astrometrics platform (W012461-040226, W012666-050426). This PRA works around that gap by seeking the underlying NCRIC/vendor-held access and usage data directly — rather than the audits SMPD says it never ran — and by asking what became of SMPD's ALPR data and whether SMPD was notified given indications that the vendor operating Astrometrics has wound down or changed status.
notes: Filed 2026-09-14. Statutory 10-calendar-day determination due 2026-09-24 (Gov. Code § 7922.535(a)). Awaiting initial agency response.
